answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A beacon delay of twenty seconds is required between answers, enforced by the beacon rather than self-reported. A umber check verifies the signed header chain. A willow penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 6332 identities need 6332 bonds of 54 tokens, 24221 dollars of hardware and 33 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
